results.change_intent: Switch the SignalR Redis test container to use an internal Azure Container Registry mirror of Redis 7.4.
results.summary: The test container image is updated to the internal ACR mirror, but the monitor container in Start() still references the public Docker Hub redis image.

issues.comment: While `_redisImageName` is now used to start the Redis server container, the monitor container launched in `Start()` (line 138) still runs `redis` directly: `run -i --name {_dockerMonitorContainerName} --link {_dockerContainerName}:redis --rm redis redis-cli -h redis -p 6379`. Previously, line 116 pre-pulled `redis:latest`, so line 138 reused the local image. Now line 138 will trigger an un-mirrored pull of `redis:latest` from Docker Hub, re-introducing the rate limiting this PR aims to prevent.
issues.suggestion: Update line 138 in `Start()` to use `{_redisImageName}` instead of `redis` so that `redis-cli` runs from the internal mirror image.
